title: Three Terms and One Short Essay
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：insight　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 insight 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the scholar ① gained the insight that no student in the library would have recorded, and he said the gaining was the whole of the term. The ② insight, meaning the thought itself and not the essay, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; insight, he said, is the only thing in a library that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of insight in that library had the same short essay beside it, and the ④ insight at the far window, meaning the line they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Insight, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the scholar said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the insight was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the thought. The ⑥ insight, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; insight, he said, is either something you gain or the only word that means both thought and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ insight had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short essay. The ⑧ insight of the whole thing, the scholar wrote in April, was one library and three terms of recording; insight, he said, is either the line at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ insight I remember is the insight recorded in the journal, which closed in 2001 and is still recorded as the quietest in the library. ⑩ Insight, my mother said in 2003, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all insight, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like thought. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 洞见；见解（指图书馆里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 洞见；见解（指那点见解本身，与随笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：gain the insight 获得这种洞见
D. n. 洞见；见解（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一点）
E. n. 见识之事（抽象总称，指一处图书馆的洞见之事）
F. n. 洞见；见解（指札记里写到、被记下的的那一点）
G. n. 意义、领悟（指一件事里人人都悟却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 领悟（抽象总称，指人人都悟却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gained the insight that no student in the library would have recorded
The insight, meaning the thought itself and not the essay
Every piece of insight in that library
the insight at the far window
the insight was the whole of the matter
the insight had become a line in a journal
The insight of the whole thing

answers.why: gain the insight 意为“获得这种洞见”，1994 年那位学者把图书馆里没有一位学生肯记录的一点洞见做了一遍。
insight 意为“洞见；见解”，指那点见解本身而不是随笔，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记录。
insight 意为“洞见；见解”，指图书馆里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一篇薄薄的随笔。
insight 意为“洞见；见解”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们照着抄的那一点，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
insight 意为“意义、领悟”，指一件事里人人都悟却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这层领悟就是那件事的全部。
insight 意为“领悟”，指人人都悟却无人提起的那样东西而不是那点见解，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
insight 意为“洞见；见解”，指札记里写到、被记下的的那一点，到 1999 年这一点成了札记里的一行。
insight 意为“见识之事”，学者四月写道，整件事的洞见之事是一处图书馆和三个学期的记录。
insight 意为“洞见；见解”，我记得的是札记里记录过的那一点，2001 年想通了，至今仍被说成图书馆里最安静的一点。
insight 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，洞见是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的见解。

那点洞见，指的是那点见解本身而不是随笔，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记录。（insight）
那处图书馆里每一点洞见旁边都有同一篇薄薄的随笔。（insight）

叔叔说这层领悟就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那点见解。（insight）
2003 年母亲说，洞见是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的见解。（insight）
